decisions.reason: The area elastic sports system is a full product line built on the firm's established sports flooring offer and had its own page, so the sunk development investment and visible commitment favour keeping it despite thin evidence on results.
The mobile arena floor line carries substantial production and development investment, and weak pandemic-era arena demand can be attributed to temporary causes, so management persists with it.

Although it overlaps with Product B as a second mobile arena system, the firm publicly presented it as its own line and would likely keep it rather than admit the duplication was a mistake, though consolidation is somewhat more likely here.
The chevron parquet sits at the core of the firm's announced trend-led, natural-aesthetic flooring direction and was featured on the home page, making it the most visibly committed product.
The squash court finish is a niche extension, but it was presented publicly, costs little to keep, and builds on the firm's surface know-how, so persistence is likely.
The oak skirting is a low-cost complementary accessory that supports the sports floor systems, so the firm has little reason to drop it.
